{{Quote|Time to retire those Z-95s! These X-wings should be able to handle anything the Empire can send at us!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]]|<ref name="EaW" />}}
The '''Fresian campaign''' was a campaign of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that occurred in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. One of the war's first major campaigns, it was prompted when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted the nationalization of the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]].

==Prelude==
Unhappy with the impending nationalization of their company, Incom scientists attempted to provide the Alliance with the location of 4 prototype [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] on [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]] to use against the Empire. The Rebels dispatched a small task force under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] to obtain the X-wings, but complications arose when the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyranny]]'' was discovered in Fresia's orbit

==Campaign==
===Luring away the ''Tyranny''===
{{Main|Space Battle at Kuat}}
[[File:Kuat_Diversion.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Antilles's task force, in formation at the beginning of the battle.]]
{{Quote|Kuat Shipyard to all Imperial units! We are under siege by significant Rebel forces! All ships in the area, respond! Emergency Code Zero!|The Imperial commander at Kuat calling for reinforcements|<ref name="EaW" />}}
In order for the task force to attack Fresia, it was first necessary to draw away the ''Tyranny'' from the planet. Antilles decided to stage an attack on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], the ''Tyranny''{{'s}} usual station, to try and draw the Star Destroyer back.

The Rebels began the attack on Kuat's orbital shipyards with 5 [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]]. the ''Tyranny'' refused to answer their distress call several times, but eventually did when the shipyard commander issued an [[Emergency Code Zero (Imperial)|Emergency Code Zero]]. The ''Tyranny'' came out of Hyperspace with its shields down, so the Rebels dealt it a great deal of damage before retreating

===Obtaining landing codes===
{{Main|Battle on Wayland}}
Even though the ''Tyranny'' had been lured away from Fresia, it had deployed several sentry drones that would prevent unauthorized ships from entering the system. The Alliance conceived a plan to use an [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] to slice into an uplink station on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] to register the Alliance ships as guests for Incom's nationalization ceremony.

The Rebels landed and quickly took the uplink station. However, the droid required time, and the Imperials fought hard to retake the station. The Alliance forces hung on long enough to steal the codes, then departed the planet under fire.

===Assault on Fresia===
{{Main|Battle of Fresia}}
[[File:BattleofFresia.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rebel forces assault the Imperial power generator.]]
{{Quote|There's no alarm on any Imperial comm channel. We're clear. Move out, team.|Captain Raymus Antilles, upon reaching Fresia with the Alliance task force|<ref name="EaW" />}}
With the landing codes secure, Alliance forces were able to safely make it to the surface of Fresia. They deployed south of the Incom facility, and quickly punched through the garrison. They advanced through the facility, until the Imperials launched a last-ditch effort in front of the location of the prototypes. The Rebels punched through, seizing the fighters. The Rebels quickly escaped with their prize.

===Rescue over Kessel===
{{Main|Space Battle in the Kessel Asteroid Field}}
{{Quote|Transmissions we've intercepted indicated that many of the captured scientists will be transferred to Kessel. We will not leave them to die in the darkness of the spice mines.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] briefing [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] on the Kessel operation|<ref name="EaW" />}}
The Empire retaliated by arresting the Incom scientists and taking them to be imprisoned on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. En route to the planet, a Rebel task force attacked the Imperial convoy, freeing the scientists.The freed Incom scientists would later prove to be invaluable to the Alliance. Their schematics allowed the Rebellion to launch the production of X-wings.

==Aftermath==
[[File:Rebel_Leaders.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The leaders of the Rebellion [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] study the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].]]
{{Quote|The Incom T-65 X-wing is the fighter that killed the Death Star. An almost perfect balance of speed, maneuverability, and defensive shielding make it the fighter of choice for Rogue Squadron.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]|<ref name="RC Commando">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>}}
The X-wing prototypes obtained from Fresia would lead the Alliance to the full production of X-wing starfighters, a design that would go on to serve with distinction throughout the rest of the Galactic Civil War and beyond. The X-wing would soon get its first opportunity to prove its worth at the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]], where it was able to defeat prototype Imperial [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/In starfighters]] of similar performance. Indeed, much of the later success of the Rebellion would be due to this superb fighter, eventually becoming the starfighter of choice for elite pilots such as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].
